epa.label: EPA
epa.filter: Early downs (1st-2nd), Q1-Q3, win probability held between 5% and 95% so garbage time is dropped. Turnovers (interceptions, lost fumbles) included. Raw per-play rates, not opponent-adjusted.
epa.teamFilter: Pass and rush plays, all downs, no win-probability filter. Turnovers (interceptions, lost fumbles) excluded, so these rates sit about +0.08 EPA/play above the published nflverse/rbsdm figures and are not comparable to them. Raw per-play rates, not opponent-adjusted.
